name: bizplug-photography
description: The photography & creative plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: book a shoot or consultation. It works from the business's own published profile, covering packages, pricing, availability and booking requests, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.

test_cases.expect: Calls show_menu, which shows the menu card; does not list the options again, or lists them exactly as returned where there is no card.
